class: NMDA receptor antagonist (pan-subunit in the WWOX use); the competitive-at-the-glutamate-site label is general knowledge and was not verified in a primary source read here
mechanism_source: 34634460 Methods 5.4 and Results 2.2 (use only); 19535488 Methods (100 uM D-AP5 or 5-10 uM D-CPP used to block NMDA receptors); 40994429 Methods (200 uM DL-APV in culture medium); no primary mechanism paper read
measured_in: Mouse neocortical slices P13-P17, 35 C, 50 uM: bursts abolished, reversible; delayed evoked response about 0.4 of baseline at 100 uA (Suppl Fig S3C), which is largely the measurement floor of the amplitude metric (wild type reads about 0.115 mV): against the floor about 20 percent of the delayed component remains (INFERENZA)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Subunit selectivity not examined in any source read; no effect on AMPA or kainate receptors was tested in the WWOX paper (absence, not negative)
specific_limit: The fraction of the NMDAR current blocked by 50 uM d-APV in the preparation was not measured; competitive blockade is surmounted by glutamate, so the fraction depends on ambient glutamate and Mg2+
depth: partial (use sources read; mechanism not primary-verified)

class: Glycyrrhetinic-acid derivative sold as a gap-junction blocker; shown in primary papers read to act also on synaptic release, GABA-A IPSCs, spike width, input resistance and to block Panx1
mechanism_source: 19535488 Results (Figs 1-4 text); 20940167 Results (CBX 100 uM, ischaemic current and propidium uptake); 23589583 Fig 6 (blocks mouse Panx1 in oocytes, concentration not stated in the legend or text)
measured_in: Mouse hippocampal autaptic culture, P0-P1 origin, 6-15 DIV, room temperature: 100 uM reduced AMPA EPSC to 63.3 +/- 4.5 percent (n = 28), NMDA EPSC to 69.1 +/- 3.2 percent (n = 14), IPSC to 49.8 +/- 5.7 percent (n = 7), spike width +24.5 percent, Rin -20.6 percent; 10 and 50 uM gave 80.0 and 79.2 percent EPSC. WWOX slices: 100 uM, frequency -87 percent, irreversible. Rat CA1 slices, 33 C, 100 uM in bath and pipette after at least 30 min: at P12 the reversed-uptake ischaemic inward current was not changed by test (about 2.1 nA, n = 6, vs about 2.7 nA, n = 14, 22 percent lower, P = 0.46); at P20 carbenoxolone was tested only together with La3+ (P = 0.43)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Not selective: gap junctions, Panx1, presynaptic release, K+ and Ca2+ conductances and possibly NMDAR channels (the last through a paper not reached here); no concentration that separates these exists in the sources read
specific_limit: The EPSC reduction recovers incompletely, whereas the IPSC reduction was rapidly and fully reversible; the CA1 slice null has low power against a 20-30 percent effect and measures an ischaemic reversed-uptake glutamate current, not evoked release, so it neither contradicts the culture result nor excludes an NMDAR block; the authors of the source say it should not be used to assess gap junction roles on network activity; the WWOX CBX result cannot be assigned to gap junctions
depth: partial_fulltext_read (19535488, 20940167); full text of the cited NMDAR paper not reached

class: Panx1 channel blocker; no action on human P2X7 or two connexin hemichannels in oocytes
mechanism_source: 23589583 Results (Panx1 block, P2X7, connexin sections), Figs 2 and 6
measured_in: Xenopus oocytes expressing mouse Panx1: IC50 0.27 uM, plateau 75 percent in the text and about 80-85 percent read from Fig 2B (about 22, 66, 80, 85 percent at 0.1, 1, 10, 100 uM); no significant block of BzATP-induced human P2X7 current at 100 uM; 100 uM did not alter Cx46 or Cx32E143 currents. WWOX slices: 10 uM, no reduction of bursts
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Selective against P2X7 and the two connexins tested in oocytes; NMDAR, AMPAR, voltage-gated Na+ channels not tested in this source (the source cites that BB FCF needs higher concentrations than Brilliant Blue G at Na+ channels); slice penetration and Panx1 block in neocortex unknown
specific_limit: Block of Panx1 by BB FCF is attenuated in four of five ATP-site alanine mutants (still about 27 percent in S240A and about 51 percent in I247A); residual 15-25 percent conductance in oocytes; in slices no positive control exists
depth: partial_fulltext_read (text read; Figs 2 and 6 viewed; Figs 1, 3, 4, 5, 7 captions only)

class: Antimalarial; blocks neuronal Cx36 gap junctions at sub-micromolar potency in transfected cells; cited in the slice study as a Panx1 blocker at lower concentration than connexins
mechanism_source: 15297615 Abstract (Cx36 IC50 about 300 nM in N2A cells; Cx50 about 1.1 uM; others 10- to 100-fold higher; 25 uM blocked interneuron coupling in neocortical slices); 20940167 Results (25 uM in CA1 slices)
measured_in: N2A transfected cells; neocortical slices at 25 uM (species and age not stated in the abstract); rat CA1 slices 25 uM: no change in ischaemic current, latency prolonged from about 382 to 544 s
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Higher selectivity among connexins than carbenoxolone in the abstract; K+ channel block is named in the second source; Panx1 IC50 about 100 nM is carried from a third paper not read; effects on AMPA, NMDA or GABA receptors not in the abstract beyond evoked PSPs unchanged
specific_limit: Full text of the Cx36 paper not reachable (bot-check page); abstract states an increase in spontaneous synaptic activity at 25 uM, so in a bursting preparation mefloquine could raise or lower bursts through non-coupling effects

class: Competitive AMPA/kainate receptor antagonist (class label general knowledge)
mechanism_source: No mechanism or selectivity paper read. Used as a tool in 19535488 Methods (5 uM NBQX to isolate NMDA EPSC), 40994429 Methods (10 uM NBQX with gabazine in CA1 slices) and 20940167 Fig 1 legend (25 uM NBQX within a blocker cocktail)
measured_in: Cultured mouse hippocampal neurons; mouse CA1 slices P17-P22, 30-32 C; rat CA1 slices P12/P20
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Selectivity (kainate, NMDA glycine site, GluN2) not verified in a primary source read; the source papers use it only as a blocker of AMPA-mediated currents
specific_limit: The package has no primary reading of NBQX mechanism; before it is placed in an arm a primary selectivity paper is needed (recorded as a gap)

mechanism_source: 25229608 Abstract; Results (Fig 1D-E, Table 1, Fig 3, Fig 4, Fig 5); Discussion
measured_in: Cultured rat hippocampal neurons (E18 origin, 7-25 DIV), temperature not stated, holding -60 mV: AMPA IC50 reported 0.4-0.9 uM peak and 0.4-1.2 uM late, kainate IC50 0.58, 0.51, 0.58 uM; Fig 1D enlarged and re-viewed in Phase 2: the printed axis numerals are spaced about 0.8 times as far apart as the long tick marks (about 96 against about 118 px in my enlarged crop; the independent audit measured 132 against 164 px), the six data points sit at half-decade spacing on the ticks, and by the numerals the last point would be at about 90 uM although Methods give a maximum of 30 uM; read by the ticks the 50 percent crossings are about 0.45 uM (10 uM AMPA) and about 1 uM (100 uM AMPA), in agreement with Table 1 (INFERENZA: probable offset of the axis labels in the raster; the earlier text-versus-figure potency conflict is withdrawn); the kinetic KD 3.9 uM is a separate, higher number that the paper does not reconcile with its IC50s; k_on 1.5e5 per molar per second, k_off 0.58 per second; 30 uM did not change NMDA 10 and 100 uM currents (n = 6)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Selective for AMPA/kainate-evoked current over NMDA in culture; kainate-receptor transient currents not separated; no slice, cortical or P13-P17 datum in this source; effects on voltage-gated channels not tested here (the source says there is no evidence of other targets, carried from earlier work)
specific_limit: Slow onset (about 1 s at 3 uM, about 3 s without pre-exposure) and slow offset make timing of application and washout matter; potency in the slice unmeasured; funded in part by Eisai (authors not employees)
depth: partial_fulltext_read (text; Fig 1 and Fig 5 viewed; Figs 2-4 captions)

class: GluN2B-selective negative allosteric modulator binding at the GluN1-GluN2B amino-terminal domain interface (same pocket as ifenprodil)
mechanism_source: 40994429 Results ('Crystal structure', Table 1, 'Time course and agonist dependence', 'Effects of radiprodil on mutant mice')
measured_in: Xenopus oocytes, room temperature, 100 uM glutamate and 30 uM glycine: IC50 0.029 uM (human GluN1-1a/GluN2B, 91 percent max), 0.026 uM (rat), 0.13 uM with GluN1-1b; no effect on GluN2A, GluN2C or GluN2D diheteromers (a sentence that cites Supplementary Fig 1B, which was not read: carried text); triheteromeric GluN2A/GluN2B IC50 0.091 uM with only 45 percent maximum inhibition; GluN2B/GluN2C 64 percent, GluN2B/GluN2D 65 percent; residual current at saturation; 4.7 percent recovery after 3 min washout; mouse CA1 slices P17-P22, 30-32 C, +40 mV, NBQX and gabazine present, bath Mg2+ given as 1.5 mM in the slice Methods but as 0.2 mM in the Fig 4B and Fig 5 legends, 3 uM: evoked NMDAR EPSC about 33 to 16 pA (WT) and 48 to 25 pA (S810R); PTZ onset delayed (GTCS latency 207 +/- 23 s vehicle vs 458 +/- 90 s radiprodil, 16 of 26 mice seizing) in adult heterozygous GluN2B-S810R mice, 3 mg/kg i.p.
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Selective for GluN2B-containing receptors in oocytes; use or activity dependence of radiprodil was not tested in this source; inhibition at saturation is incomplete and lower in triheteromers; no WWOX, neocortex or P13-P17 datum; the human-safety wording in the abstract carries no human data in the text read
specific_limit: Whole-cell slice recording used 3 uM, about 100-fold above the oocyte IC50 (a bath concentration is not a free concentration); memantine 10 uM (text) or 30 uM (Fig 5 legend) did not inhibit the S810R EPSC; the in vivo result is in a GluN2B gain-of-function model
depth: partial_fulltext_read (main text and tables read; figures not available in the open-data bucket; supplementary not read)

class: GluN2A-preferring negative allosteric modulator of glycine binding at the GluN1-GluN2A agonist-binding-domain interface
measured_in: Xenopus oocytes (room temperature, -40 mV) and HEK293 cells (-60 mV): GluN1/GluN2A IC50 320 nM at 3 uM glycine; 100 nM at 1 uM glycine; 1.6 uM at 30 uM glycine; no inhibition by 10 uM at 300 uM glycine; Kb 45 nM, allosteric constant 0.0025; no inhibition of GluN2B, GluN2C or GluN2D; the statement that 10 uM did not affect GluA1 or GluK2 is 'data not shown'; Table 1 gives maximum inhibition 81 +/- 1 percent at 3 uM glycine and 73 +/- 2 percent at 30 uM glycine while the text says 'completely inhibited'; solubility limit 18 uM (stated in the Results paragraph on Fig 9)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Greater than 1000-fold selective for GluN2A at 3 uM glycine in recombinant receptors; inhibition depends on glycine (and D-serine) occupancy; slice, native triheteromer and native co-agonist data absent from this source
specific_limit: Maximum inhibition is incomplete in the source's own table (73-81 percent), so a plateau below abolition does not by itself indicate another receptor population; potency in tissue depends on unknown co-agonist level; the solubility ceiling (18 uM) bounds the achievable shift; no slice or P13-P17 data; a negative result with it in slices would need a co-agonist measurement
depth: partial_fulltext_read (text read; figures not available in the open-data bucket)
